steps.text: Each row records one action: the timestamp, the action type, the affected entity, who did it, and the source. The change you just made appears at the top of the list.
steps.title: The audit log

steps.text: Click a row to show the details of the event.
steps.title: Event details

steps.text: Clicking a row expands its JSON payload — here, the list of changed fields. This is the full technical record of exactly what changed.
steps.title: The action details

steps.text: Use the filters to narrow things down, for example by entity type, action, id or date range.
steps.title: Filter the log

steps.text: The "Clear filters" button wipes every criterion at once and shows the whole log again.
steps.title: Reset the filters

steps.text: The "Export" button downloads the full log as a CSV file — handy for archiving or handing it to your regulator.
steps.title: Export the log
